about: L4 firmware anchors (device-twins spec §4): reference firmware on Espressif QEMU 9.2.2, the twin compared with it (differential test). Same runs as anchors-20261031T200000Z.json (source ~/vesper-lab/anchors/results-L4.md, run 2026-10-31 on the catalog of that day, before the final catalog build); this file restates the credit: an anchor runs reference firmware of a device type, not a product's, so it credits the twin model it names. The ESPHome plug is not Tasmota's firmware and credits nothing; it is kept as a check of the plug's switching and MQTT session.

anchors.why_not: ESPHome is not Tasmota's firmware and speaks another MQTT protocol
